first_contact_policy: Personalized first-contact emails to verified strong new matches with published business or organizational addresses. Check existing email and form records immediately before sending; avoid duplicate, bounced or opted-out contacts. Exact sends logged. No automatic replies or extra follow-ups in the prospect task.
reply_and_followup_policy: The captured prospect task excludes automatic replies and extra follow-ups. Follow explicit current task instructions.
recording_scope: Importing or reading these records does not itself send email or change active automations.
